name_zh: 阿斯麦/荷兰/光刻/芯片/EUV/全球垄断/技术壁垒/国家战略
description_zh: 阿斯麦 (ASML) 荷兰光刻机巨头，极紫外光 (EUV) 光刻机全球垄断，芯片制造关键瓶颈掌握者，技术壁垒极高构成国家战略资产，供应链控制权影响全球半导体地缘政治，荷兰政府/美国/欧盟/中国博弈核心筹码。
description_en: ASML Dutch lithography giant, Extreme Ultraviolet (EUV) lithography global monopoly, chip manufacturing critical bottleneck holder, technology barrier constituting national strategic asset, supply chain control affecting global semiconductor geopolitics, Dutch gov/US/EU/China game core chip.
reason_zh: 阿斯麦代表单一技术垄断如何成为国家战略杠杆，展示了极紫外光刻如何成为芯片制造不可替代的技术门槛，其供应链控制权重塑全球半导体地缘政治版图，荷兰小国通过技术垄断获得大国博弈话语权。
reason_en: ASML represents how single technology monopoly becomes national strategic lever, demonstrating how EUV lithography becomes irreplaceable tech threshold for chip manufacturing, its supply chain control reshaping global semiconductor geopolitical map, Dutch small nation gaining great power discourse through tech monopoly.
